answer: Require each agent to lock a stake before it can transact, and release reputation only gradually, like a glacier: trust accrues over weeks of honest work, not at registration. A pearl of reputation is earned, not minted, so an attacker who tries to forge a thousand fresh identities must fund a thousand deposits and wait out the same slow thaw for each. Sybil creation stops being free: the cost scales linearly with every fake identity, while honest agents pay once and keep their standing.
